items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: That was myself, Lionel Furbaugh, played trumpet, and a tenor player you called Antwine.

ctx.x: What's the name of the band? Just three. What's the name of the band? Just three from here.

That was myself, Lionel Furbaugh, played trumpet, and a tenor player you called Antwine. Yeah, I don't know. I might have heard of him on that. In fact, I haven't seen Antwine in a long time. When I see Lionel Furbaugh quite often. But that was the only three men in this Miss Broadway show from here at that time. All the rest of them was from Chicago.
How did they play? Did you notice any difference in their style? Did they play much jazz or mostly just other songs for the show?
